text:
AR462
Capstone Seminar in Archaeology
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This seminar
course
introduces
students
to current research and theoretical paradigms both within and outside their area of
specialization
and is team-taught by faculty who will present aspects of their own research. All students will participate in classroom discussions centering on weekly topics.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
AR219
* and
AR460
(AR360) or permission of the department.
Exclusions
AN460*, AR460*, CL462, NE462.
